newBranch.description: Present when the new event created a branch. Its entry already carries the spans it inherits.

runStarted.description: Present when the new event started a run: the id of the run whose span starts at this tick on `branchId`.

runsEnded.description: Present when the new event closed runs: the ids of the runs whose span on `branchId`'s line ends at this tick. tick.description: The new highest stored tick.

highestTick.description: The highest stored tick that has no missing tick below it.

IngestAccepted.description: The event is stored. `duplicate` is true when the same event (same id and content) was already stored; the existing record is returned.

IngestRefusalReason.description: Why the service refused one event. `run_in_progress`: a snapshot (not the first) or an outside change arrived while a run on the branch is running.

IngestRefused.description: The event is not stored. `rebuild` carries the rebuilder's own answer when the reason is `invalid_event`.

editor.description: The editor sending the events; the claimant of the one-recorder lease.

instanceId.description: The recorder instance sending the events (for example one browser tab).

ownTicks.description: Ticks of this branch's own events, sorted from lowest to highest, none twice.

parentTick.description: The parent's last tick included in this branch. Absent only for the root.

runSpans.description: The runs that matter on this branch's own part of its line: runs started on its own events, plus runs started on an ancestor that were still open at this branch's branch point (their `startedTick` lies on the parent's part of the line). SearchHit.description: A past moment where the query was found.

snippet.description: A short piece of the matching text.

SearchHitKind.description: What kind of thing a search hit is.

ServiceInfo.description: What a service says about itself.

schemaVersion.description: The event schema version the service accepts.

StateAtRequest.description: Ask for the rebuilt state at a position. The answer is a `RebuildResult`.

branchCount.description: Which event this is along the branch's line (1 to n), counted up to `lastEventTick`; worked out, not stored.

lastEventTick.description: The tick of the last event on the line at or before `tick`; the content reflects this event.

tick.description: The tick that was asked for (where the user is looking). It may fall between events.

StoreLimits.description: Size limits and intervals. Every field is optional; a missing field uses its default (in brackets).

inlineOutputBytes.description: Output kept inline in the event, up to this size (16384).

truncatedPreviewBytes.description: Preview kept of a truncated output (262144).

Tick.description: A positive whole number: the running order of one event.
